units.title: SG-1.2 Write pure grid-to-pixels and sprite-sheet functions
Act: Add gridToRgba to the art module
Act: Add buildSpriteSheet to the art module

tests.id: pixelGrid.test.ts > gridToRgba > sizes and palette-only colours > reports width, height and data length
tests.name: reports width, height and data length
tests.title: gridToRgba reports width, height and data length
tests.scenario: Given a 3x2 grid of palette indices, when converted, then width is 3, height is 2 and data length is 24

tests.id: pixelGrid.test.ts > gridToRgba > sizes and palette-only colours > uses only palette colours
tests.name: uses only palette colours
tests.title: gridToRgba uses only palette colours with full alpha
tests.scenario: Given a grid with indices 0, 7 and 47, when converted, then each pixel's hex is in PALETTE and its alpha is 255

tests.id: pixelGrid.test.ts > gridToRgba > transparency, errors, determinism > yields alpha 0 for index -1 (transparent)
tests.name: yields alpha 0 for index -1 (transparent)
tests.title: gridToRgba makes transparent pixels alpha 0
tests.scenario: Given a grid with a single -1 pixel, when converted, then its alpha is 0

tests.id: pixelGrid.test.ts > gridToRgba > transparency, errors, determinism > throws RangeError for invalid palette index 48
tests.name: throws RangeError for invalid palette index 48
tests.title: gridToRgba rejects palette index 48 with RangeError
tests.scenario: Given a grid with index 48, when converted, then a RangeError is thrown

tests.id: pixelGrid.test.ts > gridToRgba > transparency, errors, determinism > throws RangeError for invalid palette index -2
tests.name: throws RangeError for invalid palette index -2
tests.title: gridToRgba rejects palette index -2 with RangeError
tests.scenario: Given a grid with index -2, when converted, then a RangeError is thrown

tests.id: pixelGrid.test.ts > gridToRgba > transparency, errors, determinism > throws RangeError for invalid palette index 1.5
tests.name: throws RangeError for invalid palette index 1.5
tests.title: gridToRgba rejects non-integer palette index 1.5 with RangeError
tests.scenario: Given a grid with index 1.5, when converted, then a RangeError is thrown

tests.id: pixelGrid.test.ts > gridToRgba > transparency, errors, determinism > throws for ragged rows
tests.name: throws for ragged rows
tests.title: gridToRgba rejects ragged rows
tests.scenario: Given rows of length 2 and 1, when converted, then an error is thrown

tests.id: pixelGrid.test.ts > gridToRgba > transparency, errors, determinism > is deterministic for the same grid
tests.name: is deterministic for the same grid
tests.title: gridToRgba returns equal output for the same grid
tests.scenario: Given the same grid converted twice, then both results are deeply equal

tests.name: buildSpriteSheet > metadata and placement > reports sheet and frame dimensions, frame count and data length
tests.title: reports sheet and frame dimensions, frame count and data length
tests.scenario: Given 4 frames of 32x48, when buildSpriteSheet runs, then width is 128, height 48, frameWidth 32, frameHeight 48, frameCount 4 and data length 128*48*4

tests.name: buildSpriteSheet > metadata and placement > places each frame left to right, matching its gridToRgba top-left pixel
tests.title: places each frame left to right, matching its gridToRgba top-left pixel
tests.scenario: Given 4 frames filled with indices 0..3, when built, then the pixel at (k*32, 0) equals the first 4 bytes of gridToRgba(frame k)

tests.name: buildSpriteSheet > palette, errors, determinism > uses only palette colours for every opaque pixel
tests.title: uses only palette colours for every opaque pixel
tests.scenario: Given 4 frames of palette indices 0..3, when built, then every pixel with alpha > 0 has a colour present in PALETTE

tests.name: buildSpriteSheet > palette, errors, determinism > throws when given no frames
tests.title: throws when given no frames
tests.scenario: Given an empty frame list, when buildSpriteSheet runs, then it throws

tests.name: buildSpriteSheet > palette, errors, determinism > throws when a frame is 2x2 instead of the first 32x48 frame size
tests.title: throws when a frame is 2x2 instead of the first 32x48 frame size
tests.scenario: Given a 32x48 frame followed by a 2x2 frame, when built, then it throws

tests.name: buildSpriteSheet > palette, errors, determinism > throws when a frame is 3x2 instead of the first 32x48 frame size
tests.title: throws when a frame is 3x2 instead of the first 32x48 frame size
tests.scenario: Given a 32x48 frame followed by a 3x2 frame, when built, then it throws

tests.name: buildSpriteSheet > palette, errors, determinism > throws when a frame contains an invalid palette index 99
tests.title: throws when a frame contains an invalid palette index 99
tests.scenario: Given a frame containing palette index 99, when built, then it throws

tests.name: buildSpriteSheet > palette, errors, determinism > is deterministic: two builds of the same frames give identical bytes
tests.title: is deterministic: two builds of the same frames give identical bytes
tests.scenario: Given the same frames, when built twice, then the data arrays are equal byte for byte

units.title: REQ · gridToRgba converts a palette-indexed grid to RGBA and rejects bad indices
REQ · buildSpriteSheet lays equal-size frames into one horizontal sheet with size and frame metadata
Evidence: grid-to-RGBA and sprite-sheet unit tests pass
